explanation: This function is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) because value is concatenated into an HTML <span> element and wrapped in Django's mark_safe(), bypassing template auto-escaping. Crafted markup in value could execute arbitrary client-side scripts in users' browsers. The repair replaces mark_safe() and concatenation with Django's format_html(), which automatically HTML-escapes value while marking only the static template safe.
